title: Make your portfolio clear, honest and proven
course_title: Online Portfolio Building: Show Your Best Work and Win Clients

say: Make your portfolio clear, honest and proven.
This is the video for module three of Online Portfolio Building.
A portfolio with excellent work can still lose customers. Most visitors open your link on a phone, often on a slow connection, and they give up quickly if the page is confusing.

say: Every piece you show is a promise. If one piece is not really yours, a customer stops believing everything else.

say: Start with Home: your name, a headline, your best piece and a contact button. A good headline says what you do, for whom, and where. For example, bridal and event makeup for brides in Kano and nearby.

Services: what you offer, prices from
Contact: WhatsApp, email, area, hours

say: Edits may improve the photo. Cropping clutter, brightening and straightening are fine.
But if the customer would receive something different from the photo, the edit is misleading. And if you use an AI tool for a mock-up, say so. Never pass it off as a real product.

Once your work is public, watch for three dangers. First, a client who sends more than the price and asks you to send back the difference. Do not send money back. Confirm the payment in your bank app, not a screenshot or SMS alert.

cards.d: A 'client' pays too much and asks for the difference back. Do not send. Check your bank app, not an SMS.
Nobody needs your OTP, card PIN or BVN to pay you. Refuse. If you shared one, call your bank at once.
A full logo and five flyers is the job, not a test. Offer a small paid first stage instead.

say: Second, anyone asking for your OTP, card PIN or BVN to pay you. Refuse. If you shared an OTP by mistake, call your bank's official customer care number at once.

cards.d: A 'client' pays too much and asks for the difference back. Do not send. Check your bank app, not an SMS.
Nobody needs your OTP, card PIN or BVN to pay you. Refuse. If you shared one, call your bank at once.
A full logo and five flyers is the job, not a test. Offer a small paid first stage instead.

say: Third, a large free test. For example, Oluchi was asked for a full logo and five flyers as a test. She offered three logo ideas for approximately 15,000 naira, going towards the full price. The person stopped replying, and she kept her ideas.

say: Before tracking, test. Show someone your home page for five seconds, then hide it. Ask: what do I do, who is it for, how would you contact me? Then ask every new enquirer one question: how did you find me? Write the answer in a notebook or a free Google Sheet.

card.title: Ask: how did you find me?

say: For example, Tolu found the portfolio link on WhatsApp status and booked lunch packs worth 45,000 naira. Bimpe found the link in an Instagram bio and ordered a cake worth 30,000. These figures are illustrative.

card.title: Ask: how did you find me?
rows: Bimpe, cake, link in Instagram bio

say: Each month, review your tracker and change one thing at a time, so you can see what made the difference. Enquiries and jobs matter more than views.

card.title: Ask: how did you find me?
rows: Bimpe, cake, link in Instagram bio

say: To remember. Put what you do, for whom and where at the top. Make contact one tap, and test it. Never let an edit change the item.
Never share your OTP, PIN or BVN. And track every enquiry, changing one thing at a time.
